Lee (eng-infra): Heads up — we’re running into capacity contention in eu-ap for live inference. Proposal: reserve 6x H100s (12mo commit) + keep 2x on-demand burst GPUs for traffic spikes. Need an internal spend approval + guidance on whether we should start at 6 or 3.
Maria (eng-platform): Could you post the cost delta vs on-demand and the account/cost-center we should charge?
Lee (eng-infra): Sure — quick numbers below. Detailed sheet: https://redwoodinternal/infracosts/eu-ap-h100 (internal)

```
Commit: 6 H100 * $4,000/mo per GPU * 12mo = $288,000/yr
Burst (on-demand estimate): 2 H100 * $150/hr * ~100hrs/month = $30,000/yr (~$2.5k/mo)
Total first-year ~ $318,000 (includes small buffer for regional egress and support)
If we start with 3 reserved + 3 on-demand: ~ $162k committed/yr + higher on-demand spend during peak (~+$60k/yr) -> total ~ $222k/yr
```
Anika (finance): Thanks. Two asks: (1) show how this maps to monthly burn and forecast, and (2) justification for reserved vs hybrid. Finance needs PO/charge code before we can move budget.
billing-bot: Current eu-ap committed spend forecast (next 30d): $120,450. Adding 6x H100 commit increases committed run-rate by ~$24k/mo.
Sam (eng-ml): For context, Q3 model rollout increases token throughput ~35% in AP region. Without reserve we’ll see 20-40% latency p90 regressions during peak. Reserved capacity reduces tail latency and avoids outages for Dedicated customers.
Maria (eng-platform): Ops note — We can gate the reservation behind a canary: provision the 6 GPUs but route 30% of traffic for 2 weeks to validate perf. If perf regressions persist we can fallback to routing to USW until rollback completes.
Anika (finance): From finance POV: approve in principle for 3x H100 (12mo) now, and revisit expansion to 6x after canary/metrics. Need an updated forecast and a PO by EOD tomorrow to align with vendor pricing window.
Lee (eng-infra): Okay will open the PO request. Proposed cost center: INFRA-EU-AP. I'll prepare the canary runbook and a short ROI note showing expected cost/unit improvement (latency -> retention -> revenue signal).
Sam (eng-ml): Suggest we add an eval metric: 95th pct latency and error-rate per 100k requests pre/post. If both improve -> green to scale.
Maria (eng-platform): Also adding an ops checklist: kernel patches, driver versions, and NVLINK topology verification. I'll schedule a brief window with infra team.
Anika (finance): Marking as "approved pending PO & forecast". Once PO submitted, finance will finalize transfer from cloud-ops slack budget. :white_check_mark:
Lee (eng-infra): Thanks — I'll submit PO + forecast link in this thread, + tag @Anika. Expect them before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Reservation quote generated: quote-id rsv-euap-2026-09-001, expires in 72h.
